newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs firm in quiet activity, players await APIs.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs firm in quiet activity, players await APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were slightly firmer Tuesday despite quiet activity.
Propane values in the Mont Belevieu, Texas, market were pegged at 35.25 and 35.50 cents a gallon, up a quarter cent from Monday. August propane was talked at 35.50 cents a gallon.
Propane values in the Conway, Kansas, market rose slightly to 34.00/34.50 cents and material traded at 34.38 cents a gallon.
"The market is a little firmer because sellers are raising prices, which is bringing buyers right along, but even so there's not much activity," one trader said.
Other players said activity was slow in both hubs as players waited for API industry data and as the month was coming to a close.
Isobutane deals in the Belvieu hub were done at 44 cents and iso values there went up to 43.75/44.25.
Ethane purity in Belvieu went up a quarter cent to 20.25/20.75. Ethane deals there were made at 20.25 for current month and 20.50 for August.
